title: Filtering the employees table by text · part 2

steps.title: Keep rows where hire_date is 2023-01-10
steps.prompt:
WHERE is a sieve: only rows that pass the test stay.
Text values wear quotes, like '2023-01-10'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE hire_date = '2023-01-10';
hints: Wrap the text value in single quotes.
Write: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE hire_date = '2023-01-10';

steps.title: Search with LIKE for '023' anywhere
steps.prompt:
Putting % on BOTH sides matches the text anywhere.
This %023% means 'contains'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE hire_date LIKE '%023%';
hints: Wrap the text in %% on both sides.
Write: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE hire_date LIKE '%023%';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM employees WHERE hire_date LIKE '%023%';
